children: Enova intends to issue $500,026,000 of Series 2026-1 fixed-rate asset-backed notes secured by a revolving pool of OnDeck small business loans.
$500,026,000 initial principal across four classes (A–D) in a private securitization to close ~Sept 25, 2026, subject to conditions.
Class A–D principal: $235.275M, $114.637M, $94.742M, $55.372M respectively; fixed rates 5.61%–8.28%.
KBRA expected to rate notes at closing: anticipated ratings AA(sf), A-(sf), BBB-(sf) and BB(sf) by class.
Collateral is revolving OnDeck small business loans; Issuer sole obligor — notes not obligations or guarantees of Enova or OnDeck.
Proceeds used to buy loans from OnDeck, fund reserve account; offering to QIBs under Rule 144A and offshore under Regulation S.
